title: Transport
description: Learn how to use buses, autos, and trains — and ask where you need to go in Tamil.

exercises.explanation: Auto-rickshaws (autos) are everywhere in Tamil Nadu — knowing how to negotiate and give directions is essential.

exercises.question: How do you tell an auto driver 'go to the station'?
exercises.explanation: 'Station ponga' = go to the station (polite). Or say 'station-kku ponga' for clarity.
'Station-kku evvalavu?' = how much (to go) to the station? '-kku' marks the destination.

exercises.sentence: Bus ___ enga irukku? (Where is the bus stop?)
exercises.explanation: 'Bus stop enga irukku?' = where is the bus stop? You can also say 'bus nilayam'.
'Chennai-kku oru ticket kodunga' = please give one ticket to Chennai.
exercises.hint: sounds like: Chen-nai-kku or-u tik-ket ko-dung-guh

exercises.question: How do you say 'stop here' to an auto driver in Tamil?
exercises.explanation: 'Inge nillunga' = stop here (polite). 'Nillunga' = please stop, 'inge' = here.

exercises.prompt: Tell the auto driver: 'go to the hospital'
exercises.explanation: 'Hospital-kku ponga' = go to the hospital. '-kku' = to (destination marker).

exercises.prompt: is there a bus to Chennai
exercises.explanation: 'Chennai-kku bus irukka?' = is there a bus to Chennai? A very practical question at any bus stand.
